email.subject: AI for Belkin Burden Goldman, LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Derrick,

Belkin Burden Goldman's real estate practice spans everything from co-op and condo boards to complex commercial litigation, and managing that depth across 60 attorneys requires tools built for precision, not one-size-fits-all solutions.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of mid-sized practices: client trust, accuracy, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding and meeting regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping firms like Belkin Burden compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
